author: Posighdun
body:
=----- Horizon LFM -----=  
t5 lets get it
 DO NOT APPLY IF YOU CANT SPEAK English and Spanish. (MAINLY ENGLISH) 
 
Current Roster: https://avicus.net/teams/1337#membersTab


Minimum Requirements;
  • You have some sort of experience with a competitive Avicus or Overcast Team.
  • Follow instructions given by the leader of the scrim. 
  • You must be able to attend scrims regularly 
  • You actively check your discord, to be informed of changes or scrims.
  • You can speak or at least understand some english clearly.
  • You can work with a team and hold your own during pvp situations.
The format is as follows. If, for some reason, you wish to post it privately then pm me your application on discord. Otherwise, post it bellow. If we are interested we'll add you onto discord.

TIMEZONE:
Discordtag:
 POSITION:
WILL YOU BE ACTIVE?:
Do you have access to Teamspeak and access to a working microphone which you will use?:
Past Team experience (OCN Teams/Tournments are acceptable to put):

Just be aware:
We are a team fully focused on practicing, learning and improving as individuals. So we will be scrimming heaps and we won't be one of those teams that sit back and relax until tournament time, we'll be improving our own skills to the point where we are confident. So if you're one of those guys who think you are a god, you know everything and you don't want to improve then we suggest you don't apply. If you're someone who always strives to improve your own skill then we highly recommend you apply, no harm can come from applying :P .

Good luck.

Hi Posighdun. I'm keen to get back into Avicus so I'm reapplying!
-----------------------------------------------------------------
Some helpful Information
  • You have some sort of experience with a competitive Avicus or Overcast Team - I was in Cronus for about 6 months
  • Follow instructions given by the leader of the scrim - I can do that easily
  • You must be able to attend scrims regularly - Will be my biggest challenge but I will try. If not I will leave
  • You actively check your discord, to be informed of changes or scrims - I don't actively check it but I can start doing so.
  • You can speak or at least understand some english clearly - Yes Si soy englas !!
  • You can work with a team and hold your own during pvp situations - If you want to look at some of my PvP I have videos. (I think I'm decent but that's for you to decide)
-----------------------------------------------------------------
